correction_principles: Start from frontier cases and primitive shifts, not owned artifacts.
Generate opportunity spaces before product names.
Use mature trust-system analogies to expand imagination.
Label imagination, evidence, hypothesis, and validation separately.
Audit decision biases before committing to a route.

failure_modes.correction_required: Force architecture-core vs buyer-wedge separation before route commitment.
failure_modes.evidence_from_e32_e33: E32 moved from Y* unique fitness to Black Box quickly; E33 operationalized the artifact rather than widening the imagination space.
failure_modes.reusable_ceo_reasoning_invariant: Force architecture-core vs buyer-wedge separation before route commitment.

failure_modes.correction_required: Require case archaeology before choosing the sample that represents the company.
failure_modes.evidence_from_e32_e33: The E31 paid package was convenient and concrete, so E33 used it as sample action.
failure_modes.reusable_ceo_reasoning_invariant: Require case archaeology before choosing the sample that represents the company.

failure_modes.correction_required: Keep safety, but require a separate commercial shock and buyer-pain test.
failure_modes.evidence_from_e32_e33: E33 favored friendly walkthrough because it is safe.
failure_modes.reusable_ceo_reasoning_invariant: Keep safety, but require a separate commercial shock and buyer-pain test.

failure_modes.correction_required: Future CEO research must analyze cases, roles transformed, primitives changed, and institutional failures.

failure_modes.reusable_ceo_reasoning_invariant: Future CEO research must analyze cases, roles transformed, primitives changed, and institutional failures.

failure_modes.correction_required: Add structured case archaeology with primitive, role, actor, void, pain, and opportunity extraction.

failure_modes.reusable_ceo_reasoning_invariant: Add structured case archaeology with primitive, role, actor, void, pain, and opportunity extraction.

failure_modes.correction_required: Run analogy transfer before naming market wedges.
failure_modes.evidence_from_e32_e33: Black Box analogy was used but not systematically compared with financial audit, SOC2, insurance, PR review, escrow, or chain-of-custody systems.
failure_modes.reusable_ceo_reasoning_invariant: Run analogy transfer before naming market wedges.

failure_modes.correction_required: Generate broad opportunity spaces before selecting products.
failure_modes.evidence_from_e32_e33: E32 generated 5 MVP candidates; the owner wants a much larger strange-but-plausible opportunity space.
failure_modes.reusable_ceo_reasoning_invariant: Generate broad opportunity spaces before selecting products.

failure_modes.correction_required: Attach commercial reality tests to each opportunity.
failure_modes.evidence_from_e32_e33: E33 did not test who has budget, who can say yes quickly, or what would trigger a paid experiment.
failure_modes.reusable_ceo_reasoning_invariant: Attach commercial reality tests to each opportunity.

failure_modes.correction_required: Separate language hypotheses from evidence and validate only after approval.
failure_modes.evidence_from_e32_e33: E33 prepared buyer phrasing but did not compare multiple buyer languages.
failure_modes.reusable_ceo_reasoning_invariant: Separate language hypotheses from evidence and validate only after approval.

failure_modes.reusable_ceo_reasoning_invariant: Require explicit architecture-core, wedge, proof object, and buyer-context mapping.

failure_modes.correction_required: Require opportunity categories beyond audit, dashboard, preflight, and review.

failure_modes.reusable_ceo_reasoning_invariant: Require opportunity categories beyond audit, dashboard, preflight, and review.
